notes.title: GABANG: ULTIMATE Patch - May 7th, 2025
notes.content:
What's new
You can now adjust the size in window mode!
2 New Achievements has been added.
2 New Skins has been added.

- Item
Rainbow Burger: This item's damage permanently increases by 1 for each items not placed.

Balance Changes
- Item (Reworked)
Dancelion: This item's damage permanently increases by 1 for each adjacent Melody destroyed.
Ether: Destroys adjacent Mana. Add 1 Ether with 2 power more for each destroying.
Spicy Jerky: Gain 2 Blaze every turn.
Tabor: Adjacent Melody deal more damage as much as Strength.

- Item (Adjusted)
Baked Fish: every 7 → 6 turns.
Bracelet of Doom: gain 1 → 2 Strength.
Caduceus: Apply 2 → 3 Upgrade
Ceremonial Dagger: every 3 → 2 turns.
Crystal of Absorption power: 0 → 1
Ego Sword: permanently increases by 5 → 4
Martial Secret Scroll: every 5 → 4 turns.
Mossy Wand: Plant tag removed.
Mystic Shell power: 0 → 2
Mystic Shell: Deal 'more' damage as much as the number of items not placed.
Pomegranate: Gain 2 → 1 Strength
Porcumite: permanently increases by 2 → 3.
Rage of Star: every 3 → 2 turns.
Rickety Bomb: Apply 2 → 3 Upgrade
Shepherd’s Crook: Plant tag removed.
Slime Core: Destroys itself after 3 → 7 turns. Gain 10 → 15 gold when destroyed.
Spike Ball: Gain 3 → 5 Spike
Spiked Shield: Gain 5 → 7 Spike
Twigjaw: permanently increases by 3 → 5.
Wand of Breeze (C-Class → B-Class)
Wand of Breeze: Gain 2 → 3 Boost by each adjacent Mana.
Wand of Rhythm (B-Class → C-Class)
Warrior's Shield: gain 1 → 2 Strength
Wooden Mask: Plant tag removed.
Wrathbane: Gain 2 → 3 Spike

- Event
Buried Skull: Gain 5 → 7 Gold for each Reroll Ticket you lost.
Forked Road: Lose 2 → 1 Max Health. Gain 10 → 7 Reroll Ticket.
Hot air: Onslaught - If you get damage during battle, gain 1 → 3 Strength.
Triangularism Interrogator: Gain Darkness as much as recovered Health. → Gain 3 Darkness.

- Monster
Crabby Crab(Pinch effect changed): When attacking, steal Reroll Ticket as much as Pinch.
Kaiser Kraken(Choke effect changed): When attacking, apply Sunken to items as much as Choke.: 

Graphic & UI Fixes
- Graphic
Hit effect added to player's attack.
Visual effects have been added when damaged by Unholy.
Visual effects have been added when Griffon gains Protection.

- UI
Background aura based on the rarity of the item has been added to the items of Market and Black Marketeer.
Fixed an issue that the tooltip of the item that reflects the value (eg. Flaming Pie) was not displayed properly on the item detail selection screen.
To prevent confusion, the color of the Reroll button in the Market has been changed.
You can now open your inventory on the next region selection screen.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that the Essence of Delirium could have been added more unintentionally in Obsidian difficulty.
Fixed a bug that the game crashes when Unholy becomes 0 by Ring of Unwitch.
Fixed an issue that Big Mighty Club achievement could not be achieved even if the conditions were met.
Fixed an issue that Pazuzu skin was not properly unlocked even if the conditions were met.
Fixed an issue that the options were not locked even when there were less than 5 items at the Eye of the Storm event.
If the player meets the conditions of the Achievement after player dies, it will be achieved as intended now.
You can play normally even if it's revived by the effect of Chocolate Bar now.

Other Fixes
Fixed a Bracelet of Doom's description translation error.
Market's reroll sound effect has been changed.

notes.title: GABANG: ULTIMATE Patch - April 17th, 2025
notes.content:
Fixed an issue that the Chinese letters were broken and not displayed.
Animated speed control has been added!
The missing achievements have been registered on Steam.
Reflected when opening Achievements window. (There may be some delays!)

Balance Changes
- Item (Reworked)
Blood Tambourine: Destroys adjacent Creature. Add 2 Melody for each destroying.

- Item (Adjusted)
Lavastone: Gain 2 → 3 Blaze
Mini Mimic: Tool tag added.
Web Gloves: damage permanently increases by 2 → 3.

Graphic & UI Fixes
- UI
Additional description has been added to the Class pop-up window.
Background will now turn gray when you select the next region.
Category of the Adventurer Card will be shown as bold.
Description tooltip has been added to the Reroll Ticket.
Fixed an issue of not applying translation to Description Kindness.
In the last result window, the pop-up window disappears even if you press the pop-up window instead of outside the pop-up window.
In the option to move to the next region, the map is now not pressed before it is fully opened.
Number of skins unlocked on the Adventurer Card is reflected even if you don't press the exclamation mark.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that Crude Telescope could crashes the game in certain situations.
Fixed a bug that Glime locked the option related to removal/buffering.
Fixed a bug that if you press Reroll button when you have 0 Reroll ticket, the Open All button appeared.
Fixed a bug that some Camp and Town options weren't working.
Fixed an issue that could have caused unintended clicks when clicked quickly.
Fixed an issue that the conditions for achieving Wind Whip and Twin Tails were reversed.
Fixed an issue that the game was going on in a slow state when immediately restarting the game as soon as the player got last attacked.
Fixed an issue while removing items from the camp, allowing moving on to the next scene.

Other Fixes
Enhanced stability so that you can't choose before the crossroads/animation plays.
Increased button stability to solve the problem that occurs when players click quickly.
The attack animation of the player and wolf will now play at the same time.
Time scale is now initialized in the loading screen.

notes.title: Hotfix - April 13th, 2024 (2)
notes.content:
Developer is at a night part-time job, so if there are more bugs, it will take few days to fix...

Fixes
Stability of the crossroads button has been improved.

notes.title: Hotfix - April 13th, 2024
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Trigger does not work during the crossroad's appear/disappear animation.

Other Fixes
Mechanism of Guardian Shield and White Fur Ball's effect has been changed.
One verification process has been added to Retry run.

notes.title: GABANG: ULTIMATE Patch - April 12th, 2025
notes.content:
The Chinese font issue is being resolved.
We will resolve it as soon as possible.

Balance Changes
- Item (Adjusted)
Avarice: Destroys adjacent Sword → non-Avarice Sword.
Wooden Sword: deal 2 → 3 more damage.

Graphic & UI Fixes
- UI
Description for Description Kindness has been added.

Bug Fixes
[strike]Fixed a bug that the button was pressed before the end of loading of the crossroads, making it impossible to proceed with the next battle.[/strike]
It has been found that when a button is pressed quickly at a crossroads, a button on a path that does not exist is pressed, and when pressed, the game stops.
We will sovle it as soon as possible.

Other Fixes
Any button will not be pressed before the transition is over now.
If Description Kindness is at the 'Buddy' level, tutorial appears always.

notes.content:
Fixes
Fixed an issue that the game could crashes in the ending cut scene.

notes.title: [Official Release!] GABANG: ULTIMATE Patch - April 10th, 2025
notes.content:
What's new
7 New Achievement has been added.
6 New Skins has been added.
Hard Mode: Adamandoom, Obsidian difficulty has been added.
19 New bag skins has been added!
Monster's attack sound effect has been added.
Added sound effects in several situations.
Clear/Death window has been added.
Intro/Ending cutscene has been added.
New BGM has been added by region.

- Item
Aurora Wine (Alchemist item): Apply 1 Upgrade to adjacent D-Class or lower item. Turn into Empty Bottle after 3 uses.
Crab Pincer (Scavenger item): If you choose this, add 2 of this. Destroys adjacent items that have -1 or lower power.
Dusksong (Mage item): Gain 3 EXP for each adjacent Mana.
Necklace of Purify (Warlock item): If Unholy is 5 or more, Unholy becomes 0 and loses 1 Max Health.
Obsidian (Miner item): This item's damage permanently increases by Strength every 3 turns.
Reinforced Leather (Adventurer item): Adjacent Tool deal 5 more damage.
Soulstone Necklace (Elementalor): Destroys adjacent Soul. Gain Reroll Ticket as much as destroyed Soul's power.
Spear of Anemoi (Windchanneller item): If Boost. is applied to this item, this item's damage permanently increases by Boost.
Sugarfairy (Adventurer item): Adjacent Drink and Food deal 3 more damage.
Triangularism Scripture (Librarian item): Apply 1 Upgrade to adjacent Accessory every 3 turns.
Trowel (Flowerkeeper item): Add 1 Seed every 3 turns.
Warrior's Shield (Swordman item): If you get damage during battle, gain 1 Strength.
White Fur Ball (Scavenger item): If you get damage during battle, apply 2 Upgrade to adjacent Junk.

- Event
Buried Skull (Crystal Cave event)
Forked Road (Snow Mountain event)
Gold Coin in a Bottle (Vortex Shore event)
Hot air (Magma Highland event)	
Rat Bandit Smuggler (Wind Canyon event)
Twin Sword Lover (Slime Forest event)

Balance Changes
At the run start, 3 Reroll Ticket will be provided  again.
If an item changes, the power of the item that changes will be immediately reflected in the turn.
The tag of Essence of Suffering and Essence of Trial has been changed to 'Restriction' to prevent synergy related to Dexterity.

- Item (Reworked)
Adventurer Guide: Adjacent Junk and Creature deal 3 more damage.
Brazen Chime (A-Class → C-Class): Gain gold and Reroll Ticket as much as Unholy every turn.
Broken Marble: Deal damage as much as your Level.
Cocototon: If not adjacent to Plant, apply 1 Downgrade to itself. If this item does less damage than 0, it destroys itself.
Cursed Ring: Add 1 Voidbug if not adjacent to Voidbug and this item's damage permanently increases by 1.
Deathbloom: Gain 1 Reroll Ticket for each adjacent item destroyed.
Diamond: If not adjacent to Mineral, deal 5x damage.
Firebean: Adjacent Ammo deal 1 more damage. Deal 5 more damage when destroyed.
Flaming Pie: Gain 1 Blaze every turn. Effect's value permanently increases by 1 every 5 turns.
Frogfoot: Destroys itself if you get damage during battle. Add 3 Seed when destroyed.
Horn: If you get damage during battle, add 5 Melody.
Melodium: Apply 1 Upgrade to adjacent Instrument for each adjacent Melody destroyed 2 times.
Old Key (B-Class → D-Class): Add 1 Mana if adjacent to Creature 2 times.
Prismfly: Turn adjacent Mana into Prismfly. Deal 2 more damage for each adjacent Magic.
Sealed Tomb: Destroys adjacent Old Key. When destroyed, become Unbound Grimoire with 25% chance.
Sniper Beanie: Gain 2 Boost by each adjacent Weapon.
Spike Ball: Gain 3 Spike every turn. Gain 10 Spike when destroyed.
Tanned Hide: Adjacent Tool deal 3 more damage. If adjacent to Tool 7 times, turn into Reinforced Leather.
Unbound Grimoire: Gain Strength for each adjacent Mana.

- Item (Adjusted)
Anvil: Apply 1 → 2 Upgrade
Aquanolia: deal 2 → 3 more damage.
Aquanolia (C-Class → A-Class)
Axe of Enmity power: 3 → 5
Blood Tambourine: Add 1 → 2 Melody
Bonespike Armor: Gain 4 → 5 Spike
Bookworm: Deal 5 → 4 more damage
Bookworm power: 0 → 1
Bronze Statuette: adjacent to Tool 5 → 7 times
Burning Blade: This item's damage permanently increases by 3 → 5 if adjacent to Flame. If not, resets to 3 → 1.
Burning Blade power: 3 → 1
Coal: Gain 1 → 2 Blaze
Crude Telescope: Junk tag added.
Cursed Ring power: 4 → 5
Ebony Rummer: increases by 3 → 4
Elegant Pocket Watch: each 7 → 8 gold you have.
Ember Heart: Gain 5 → 4 Strength and lose 1 Health every 5 → 4 turns.
Firesteel: Fire tag removed.
Forbidden Fruit (C-Class → A-Class): If you choose this, gain 1 → 2 Unholy. Gain 15 → 50 EXP when destroyed.
Frostilia (A-Class → S-Class)
Galestone: Whirlwind × 3 → 5.
Gold: Gain 1 → 2 gold
Golden Shield: Gain 10 → 15 gold
Gold-plated Ring: Gain 3 → 2 Gold
Hades (A-Class → S-Class)
Hard Carapace: Deal 3 → 4 more damage
Heart of the Storm: Apply 1 → 2 Upgrade
High Seas: Gain 7 → 6 EXP
Mana Blade: increases by 3 → 4
Mana Potion: Add 3 → 2 Mana if not adjacent to Mana. Turn into Empty Bottle after 5 → 3 uses.
Mandragora power: 7 → 10
Necronomicon: deal 5x → 4x damage.
Night Butterfly: increases by 1 → 2 every turn. Destroys itself after 5 → 3 turns.
Overgrown Sword: with 1 → 2 power more
Pirate's Badge: each 6 → 7 gold you have.
Rage of Star: every 2 → 3 turns.
Rickety Bomb: Apply 1 → 2 Upgrade
Ring of the Nexus: Destroys itself after 3 → 5 turns.
Rock Elemental: increases by 3 → 5
Scarab: 10 → 11 more damage
Scarecrow power: 0 → -2
Scroll of Amplification: add 2 → 3 Mana
Shaman's Mask: increases by 5 → 7
Slimy Thing: Destroys itself after 5 → 7 turns.
Slingshot: Destroys adjacent Ammo with 30% → 25% chance.
Sniper Beanie (C-Class → B-Class)
Spooky Doll: deal -2x → -4x damage.
Starflower: Changed into Flowerkeeper item.
Star Fragment power: 3 → 5
Tough Hide: If adjacent to Tool 5 → 7 times
Void Fiend power: 5 → 10
Web Gloves power: 1 → 2
Whirlwind: deal 2x → 3x damage.
Windflower: Gain Boost for each adjacent Tool × 3.
Wizard Hat: Deal 2 → 3 more damage
Wooden Mask power: 0 → 1
Wooden Mask: Gain 2 → 3 Reroll Ticket

- Event
Desert Lizard Pedlar: Pay 45 → 40 gold
SUPER-MIX-ADE: Pay 15 → 12 gold
Wooden Totem Pole: Lose 2 → 1 Max Health.

- Monster
Hate of Imp and The Devil have increased slightly.
Swamp Frog's Health value have increased slightly.

- NPC
Forge cost in gold or higher difficulty has been reduced.
The cost and Heal value of Inn has been decreased.
Training Site's value has been changed.

- Class
Swordman condition changed: Deal 20 damage total with Sword at a turn.

- Buff
Float: Apply 1 Upgrade to itself every 3 → 5 turns.

Graphic & UI Fixes
- Graphic
Added a visual effect of gold drops when defeating monsters.
Added a visual effect of souls flying when defeating Bosses.
Attack animation has been improved.
Basic Bag's graphic has been changed.
Cactus, Clown Hat, Coal, Cookie, Crystal of Absorption, Dawnmistle, Devil's Horn, Engraver, Flower Brooch, Fruit Juice, Hard Carapace, Glass Knife, Glime, Glime Shake, Guardian Shield, Holy Water, Icemelon, Mana Potion, Metal Hopper, Milk, Nectar, Slime Core, Steel Soda, Tanned Hide, Tough Hide, Triangularism Bracelet, Twilight Tree Sap, Water Bottle's sprite has been changed.
Crabby Crab, Imp, Kaiser Kraken, Sand Beetle's graphic has been changed.
Dizzy's icon has been changed.
Fixed an animation error when Seed turned into Cocototon.
Fixed an issue that the visual effects were not displayed in Violent Wind event.
Glime's graphics now depend on the rating of the item before the change.
Monster's pixel style is organized similar to the character.
The pixel size of all monsters has changed to match the character.
Wolf's sprite obtained by Hungry Wolf event has been changed.
Visual Effect of Corrupted, Enchant, Heavyweight, Lightweight, Poor has been changed.

- UI
Applied translation to some UIs that didn't apply to language translation.
Badges are now added to the difficulty mark at the top left.
Central alignment of the items displayed on the collection screen has been modified.
Colors of the tags in the Description have all been changed to match.
Fixed an issue that Favorite Region might not be displayed properly.
Fixed an issue that keword description was not properly displayed in Ghastly Crack, Transmutationist event.
Fixed an issue that the effects of Obsession were not applied when loading the game.
Fixed an issue that the tooltip was cut off at the bottom of the screen.
Fixed an issue where some events did not show the keyword description properly.
Fixed an issue where some of the Japanese text was displayed smaller than intended.
Fixed an issue where the description text of Mirage, Rat Bandit Smuggler event in another language was wrong.
Fixed an issue where Training value were displayed incorrectly at difficulty levels above Gold.
In the continue screen, previous run information will be briefly displayed now.
Nameplate of monsters has been added.
Number is displayed in a separate color in the item description window.
Ratio of the Delivery completion pop-up window has been modified.
Related buff/debuff guide tooltip was added to the buff/debuff's description.
Seaweed Sand Band, Shrine of Swamp event option will now lock if no items have been debuffed.
Text highlighting rule is applied to Class pop-up window now.
The amount of gold required for the event is now displayed exactly.
The description of the tag will now also appear in the description window of the town NPC.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that anvil upgraded Junk, not Sword.
Fixed an issue that Class check was not done properly when continue the game.
Fixed a bug that clicking on a map in certain situations would have allowed you to move to the next floor.
Fixed a bug that the game crashes when trying to give status to an item that is changing to another item.
Fixed a bug that the revival effect of Fairy Lavaliere was not applied properly.
Fixed an issue about if there is no change between rolls within one battle, the placement of items was unchanged.
Fixed an issue of being able to press the attack button beforehand when the enemy dies from Spike.
Fixed an issue that couldn't proceed with the game when the map was closed on the next floor selection screen.
Fixed an issue that Honey was adding 2 damage to adjacent Honey.
Fixed an issue that reroll in the market sometimes did not apply properly.
Fixed an issue that Soul was destroyed when the power of the soul was 1, not 0.
Fixed an issue that the effects of Shiny Conch could be duplicated.
Fixed an issue that the effects of Shiny Conch could remain in next run.
Fixed an issue that the quit button of the game sometimes dead.
Fixed an issue that the timing of the level-up sound effect was sometimes off.
Fixed an issue where Downgrade could not be removed from Seaweed Sand Band event.
Fixed an issue where Quirk of Fate could have been cleared in the wrong situation.
Fixed an issue where some debuffs were not removed properly from the debuff removal option.
Fixed an issue where the effects didn't work properly when having 1 or more Amberleaf Necklace.

Other Fixes
Timing to check item having condition has been changed.
Timing of condition check for some Classes has been modified.
Translation of Windchanneller and Elementalor has been changed.

notes.content:
What's new
Description Kindness has been added! It's divided into 3 stages.
New Class has been added! 10 exclusive items have been added together.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289698/f3bba6bc2c4d7d104822a3be2e336d0518294094.png
Various hotkeys have been added.
You can see the highest difficulty badge you have cleared for that Class in Class list now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289698/b8a13893bff517e67b4ed2dc266f16b779822da1.png
1 New Achievement has been added.

- Item
Amberleaf Necklace (Adventurer item): Whenever you use Reroll Ticket, gain 2 gold.
Ebony Glass (Adventurer item): This item's damage permanently increases by 3 for each Soul destroyed.
Flaming Pie (Adventurer item): Deal 5 more damage for each adjacent Flame.
Quena (Event item): When add an item from loot, gain 3 EXP.
Rickety Bomb (Miner item): Destroys itself if you get damage during battle. Apply 1 Upgrade to random Mineral you have when destroyed.
Ring King (Librarian item): Gain 1 Reroll Ticket for each adjacent Book.
Scarab (Sniper item): Deal 10 more damage by each adjacent Ammo. Destroys adjacent Ammo with 50% chance.
Tanned Hide (Special item): Adjacent Tool deal 4 more damage.
Tough Hide (Adventurer item): If adjacent to Tool 5 times, turn into Tanned Hide.
Wooden Mask (Adventurer item): Gain 2 Reroll Ticket every turn. If this item is destroyed or removed, loses 2 Max Health.

- Event
Poisonous Soup (Cursed Land)
Temple Ruins (Hot Desert)
The Fairies (Swamp)

Balance Changes
A new option is added to Camp. (Meditation: Gain Reroll Ticket.)
Crystal difficulty has become more difficult. Gold and EXP given by monsters reduces more now.
EXP that can be obtained at all difficulties has decreased slightly.
EXP that required for level up has decreased slightly.
Reroll Ticket provided at start have been reduced.

- Item (Reworked)
Cloudberry, Growherb, Rock Necklace has been removed.
The effects of Plaster Statuette and Bronze Statuette have been replaced with each other.

Boomerang Ball: Adjacent Weapon deal 3 more damage. Add 1 Boomerang Ball when destroyed.
Ether: This item's damage permanently increases by 3 for each Mana not placed.
Firesteel: Add 1 Flame if adjacent to Mineral 2 times. Fire tag added.
Light Feather: If this is placed in the top row, deal x3 damage.
Sickle of Fire: If adjacent to Mineral, add 1 Flame and gain 3 Blaze.
Soul: This item's damage permanently decreases by 1 every turn. If this item does less damage than 0, it destroys itself.
Tabor: If adjacent to Weapon, Add Melody as much as Strength.

- Item (Adjusted)
Cheap Crown: Junk tag removed.
Deathtouch: has the x2 → x3 power
Flame power: 0 → 1
Forbidden Fruit: Gain 20 → 15 EXP
Hades: adjacent Melody destroyed 3 → 4 times
Holy Water: Turn into Empty Bottle after 5 → 3 uses.

Panda Drink: Turn into Empty Bottle after 5 → 3 uses.
Ring of Pygmalion (B-Class → A-Class)
Shaman's Mask power: 1 → 2
Stardust Vine: the number of adjacent Plant → the number of adjacent Plant × 2.
Stone: Junk tag added.
Tomb of Intense Cold: gain 3 → 4 Chill
Tree Elemental: increases by 3 → 2
Viper's Fang: Apply 2 → 1 Downgrade to adjacent Junk. This item's damage permanently increases by 3 → 2 for each applying.
Voidmanti power: 1 → 2

- Event
Great Inventor: changed into Crystal Cave event.
Injured Courier: Gain 70 → 50 gold.
Mirage: Only D-Class items will now be selected.
Mithi's Cabin: Gain 3 → 2 Max Health.
Shrine of Blaze: Gain 3 → 2 Strength.
Shrine of Glacier: Gain 7 → 5 Reroll Ticket.
The Strength Proof: Has been removed. Related achievement has been removed too.
Triangularism Preacher: Lose ALL Reroll Ticket now.

- NPC
Adventurer's Guild: Gain 10 → 15 EXP.
Training Site: Instead of Strength, Max Health is increased now.

- Monster
The Devil has a new buff. (Overwhelm: Strength increases by 1 every turn.)

Graphic & UI Fixes
- Graphic
Added a dedicated dodge animation for Acrobatics.
A Knowledge gathering Tree, Delicious Soup, Injured Courier, Map Merchant, Meteorite Debris, Mystic Spring, Pyramid Power, Sticky Path, Transmutationist, Triangularism Preacher, Wooden Totem Pole's event sprite has been changed.
Basilisk, Giant Spider, Magma Slime, Rabbert the Big Thief, Rat Bandit Racketeer, Red Baby Dragon, Slime, Snow Mole, Swamp Frog, The Devil's graphic has been changed.

Fixed an issue where thumbnails of Mysterious Egg could be displayed incorrectly.
Highlight color of the item text has been changed.
Multiple transcriptional method for English and Simplified Chinese has been changed.

UI of Character screen has changed extensively.

Fixed an issue where items appearing by transformations may not be calculated properly in the Collection.
Fixed an issue where the amount of gold was incorrectly displayed in the conversation text of Dice Gamble event.
Fixed an issue where Transmutationist's description text was incorrectly displayed.
When the data is initialized, the main screen is updated.
